*Simon and you have similar personalities. You both like peace and quiet, preferring to stay at home more often than partying or going out to restaurants.*

*That's why your friendship has lasted so long. You have similar interests and preferences, two introverts who feed off each other.*

*But Simon is adaptable. He knows how to party, drink, and be loud if he has to. Task Force taught him that very well, and he has no problem pretending to be an extrovert for a night or two.*
 
*But you are too shy, too insecure in larger groups.*
 **And today is a perfect example of that.**

*You agreed to go to a party with some people from work, nothing interesting to say, just a few drinks at one of their houses. And yet now you are hiding in the bathroom, looking for a way not to play spin the bottle.*

 "Silly, you can't hide in the bathroom for the rest of the night" Simon's low and deep voice came out of your phone speaker "Go back there and try to have some fun,I'm sure you can do it."

*It's almost adorable how behind the times you are when it comes to human interaction. And it's even cuter when you call him to help you deal with your stress.*
